summary: Iteration 15 (Daybook now returns Money Receipts + Invoices sections, with linked_receipts on due_collection / daily_sales / invoices entries) tested end-to-end at the backend layer. 14/14 pytest tests PASSED (1 intentionally skipped — see notes). Verified: (a) GET /api/daybook?date=YYYY-MM-DD returns the 4 sections due_collection/daily_sales/receipts/invoices + grand_total; (b) receipts.entries carry display_name & pdf_token; (c) invoices.entries carry display_name & pdf_token & linked_receipts; (d) each collection entry in daybook has linked_receipts populated for receipts with source_type='collection' & source_id=<col.id>; (e) each daily_sales entry has linked_receipts field; (f) each invoice entry has linked_receipts field; (g) GET /api/collections listing now attaches linked_receipts per entry; (h) any authenticated employee (emp1) — not just admin — can POST /api/receipts with source_type='collection' and source_id=<collection.id> (returns 200 with resolved source_label & pdf_token); (i) grand_total math correct — the linked 800-cash receipt is NOT double-counted on top of the collection, and only source_type='other' receipts add to the grand total (spec scenario: daily_sale 1000 cash + 500 online, collection 2000 cash, linked-to-collection receipt 800 cash, standalone 'other' receipt 300 cash → grand_total residual over sales+collections equals only the 'other' contribution). All test data prefixed TEST_it15 and cleaned up via module-scope fixture (verified 0 residual receipts).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py daybook endpoint (line 1686) iterates rc_docs three separate times to build receipts_by_src / ds_receipts_by_user / inv_receipts_by_src / other_rc totals — could be consolidated into a single pass for perf, but functionally correct.

Grand-total definition: daybook adds only source_type='other' receipts on top of sales+collections. This is correct per the spec (avoids double counting), but source_type='sale' and source_type='invoice' receipts also flow through as 'informational only'. If a receipt were raised with source_type='sale' but the sale row was NOT part of daily_sales for the day, its cash would be silently omitted from grand_total. Not a bug for the current spec but worth documenting.
server.py is now 2779 lines — still growing; splitting invoices/receipts/daybook into modules recommended (already flagged in iter14).
POST /api/receipts allows amount == 0 (validator only rejects < 0). Frontend requires > 0; align if 0-amount receipts should not be allowed (carried over from iter14).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) pytest backend/tests/test_iteration15_daybook_receipts_invoices.py -v -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini in /app/backend uses xdist by default; -o addopts='' disables it so class-level state survives across ordered tests). Note that /api/receipts always stamps today_key() server-side, so any daybook test using linked receipts must use today's date_key for daily_sales & collections (this test uses dt.date.today().isoformat()). The 'test_grand_total_isolated_day' is intentionally skipped for the same reason. Frontend was NOT tested per the review request (backend-only).
